novelty_flags.label: def:source-margins; thm:strict-margin-improvement; related_work
novelty_flags.one_line: The core calls Acartürk et al.'s equation (23) the inverse norm product, whereas the cited NeurIPS version defines its gamma-star as the norm product itself; the advertised complete-premise inclusion must be rewritten against the actual source condition.

soundness_flags.label: thm:strict-margin-improvement
soundness_flags.one_line: The stated source-comparator premise is internally inconsistent with the source-margin definition, so the claimed strict inclusion does not presently compare the proposed local projector band with Acartürk et al.'s actual equation-(23) condition.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 6, equation (23); p. 7, Theorem 1; Appendix p. 25, Theorem 1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Equation (23) defines gamma-star as min_i ||(G-dagger)_{i,:}||_2 ||G_{:,i}||_2, not its reciprocal; Theorem 1 takes eta in (0,eta-star) and gamma in (0,gamma-star) under Assumption 1.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 21-22, discussion of Theorem 14; pp. 61-62, use of Theorem 14 in the hard-intervention recovery argument
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper supplies score-based constructive CRL recovery, including transitive-closure recovery and parent-mixing representation structure under soft interventions.

The paper uses an injective linear mixing map and linear SEMs; it describes perfect interventions as removing the target's parent dependence while allowing stochasticity, and states one perfect intervention per node suffices for identifiability.
The paper controls eigenvalue perturbations uniformly over all nonempty intervention-index subsets in an unknown multi-node intervention model.
Corollary 4.5 gives a deterministic Boolean-complexity procedure approximating a spectral projector for a Hermitian-definite pencil to prescribed operator error.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Correct def:source-margins and every comparator sentence to distinguish Acartürk et al.'s product gamma-star from the reciprocal lower bound for the actual projector product; then restate the inclusion using the source's true threshold and recheck the witness constants.

Add a compact theorem-level transfer lemma explicitly mapping the source's observed-space R_X(M), eta-star, and gamma-star to the fixed-support-coordinate objects, including the exact reciprocal relationship used for projector separation.

State the public-program transcript complexity and terminal sample budget asymptotically after the corrected comparison, so the practical gain over the all-subset source condition is quantitatively visible.

recommended_next_step: Revise the Acartürk equation-(23) comparator and rebuild the strict-inclusion statement with the actual source gamma-star convention; then advance the corrected field-tier kernel to Stage 0.
